mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy within the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% does not correlate with economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals strengthening demand, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of periods with sustained HOUST increases, or correlation between HOUST and economic demand weakens (Pearson's r < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decline > 1% does not correlate with supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with low growth
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between high FEDFUNDS and low GDPC1 growth does not lead to negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not correlate with strong labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline > 1% does not correlate with weakening consumer demand.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction between low FEDFUNDS and low UNRATE does not lead to positive returns.
